headline: Where to find Pure Quartz in Palworld
title: Where to Find Pure Quartz in Palworld | Astral Mountains | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need Pure Quartz in Palworld one point zero? Head to the Astral Mountains, the snowy area in the north. Guides point to the spot near Unthawable Lake, at around minus two hundred, two fifty, where several quartz nodes sit close together. It's freezing there, so bring cold resistant armor, a flying mount and plenty of inventory space. Wild Pals may interrupt you, so clear them first. Where do you mine yours? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Pure Quartz: mine the nodes in the snowy Astral Mountains, near Unthawable Lake at around (-200, 250). Bring cold resistant armor and a flying mount.
